verdict.rationale: cubic's own 'custom agents' feature lets teams define specialized review rules that enforce organization-specific best practices, configured in cubic.yaml. This is a narrow, review-scoped form of equipping the agent for specialized tasks. missing for 10: general-purpose skill packaging or tool/skill definitions beyond review rules, documentation of how custom agents are authored and what they can do, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: Custom agents are review rules that enforce your organization's specific best practices across pull requests.
**Custom agents**: Enforce your team’s coding standards
`cubic.yaml` lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents.
